summary: Backend-only validation of iteration-7 fixes: (1) Manager can POST charges on services and contract_amount on AMC; response reflects submitted values; manager GET returns charges/contract_amount. (2) Technician GET /services and /services/{id} still strip charges (never present). (3) PATCH /api/services/{id} with status='completed' by non-admin (manager) without before+after photos → 400 'Before and After photos required to complete'; status remains prior state. (4) Admin bypass works: PATCH complete without photos → 200. (5) Technician POST /complete without photos still returns 400. (6) Regression: Termite auto-reminder still created after technician /complete with photos (auto_source='termite_annual'). Created /app/backend/tests/test_charges_amc_photos.py with 15 targeted tests — ALL PASS. Updated 2 stale assertions in /app/backend/tests/test_production_qa.py that encoded the OLD (pre-fix) 'manager charges stripped' behavior; the full regression suite (50 tests) now passes end-to-end. Total: 65/65 tests pass.

minor.issue: The 'charges' field is always present but is 0 for AMC-generated services (payment_status='amc'). This is by design but consumers may want to distinguish 'no charge yet' vs 'AMC covered'. Non-blocking.
AMC-generated child services are hard-coded charges=0 and payment_status='amc'. Manager cannot pre-seed per-visit charges at AMC creation; must PATCH each. Acceptable but worth documenting.
Error message 'Before and After photos required to complete' is not localized. Non-blocking.

action_items: No blocking actions. All 9 required bug-fix scenarios validated as PASS.
Optional: update client apps (manager UI) to actually display charges and contract_amount fields now that the backend returns them.
Optional: consider making the create_service response symmetric with GET — currently POST always echoes 'charges' key even for technician (though technicians cannot create services, so no leak).

server.py:498-500 — /complete endpoint enforces photos for ALL roles including admin — spec says 'existing behavior' preserved. Confirmed: admin calling /complete without photos would also get 400, which is consistent with the existing endpoint contract (that endpoint is technician-oriented).
server.py:596-597 — 'if user role technician' inside list_amc is dead code because line 587-588 already 403s technicians. Harmless but redundant.
